entries: {SOMEONE:!plural} arrived in {place} and mistook {first} for someone important.
{first} accidentally ordered {THING} for the whole of {place}, and the {rival} found out.
{first} told one small fib to {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and it spread through {place} by noon.
{MESSAGE:physical} meant for the {rival} landed in {first}'s hands {MANNER}.
The {rival} announced a contest for {PRIZE:!inner}, and {first} entered by mistake.
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, with no idea whose it was.
{first} was asked to {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}, and said yes without thinking.
